name: Agent-Ready Web Profile
description: Public interoperability resolver, profile contract, directory and tooling project for discovering, normalizing and routing a website's real web, data, retrieval, agent and trust interfaces.

distributions.name: ARWP public site directory
distributions.description: Initial directory of public websites that publish ARWP profiles.

distributions.name: ARWP aggregate directory statistics
distributions.description: Aggregate capability counts derived only from public directory declarations, without visitor tracking.

distributions.name: ARWP agent locale manifest
distributions.description: Experimental project-level catalog of canonical and localized llms.txt routing surfaces for agents.

distributions.name: ARWP product history
distributions.description: Machine-readable product timeline, release milestones and current maturity status.

distributions.name: ARWP AI Search & Citation Profile
distributions.description: Non-normative reusable implementation profile for citation-oriented discovery surfaces without a readiness score.

distributions.name: ARWP canonical citation index
distributions.description: Stable index of canonical answers, project-defined terms, comparisons and verified claims.

distributions.name: ARWP Agentic Web Protocol Observatory
distributions.description: Dated primary-source-reviewed map of agentic-web mechanisms and ARWP support state.

distributions.name: ARWP Claims Registry
distributions.description: Stable scoped technical claims with review status, facts, evidence links and supersession policy.

distributions.name: ARWP claim schema
distributions.description: JSON Schema for ARWP claim objects; represented as an `other` distribution because profile v0.1 intentionally does not add a schema-specific role.

distributions.name: ARWP open media and AI reuse rights
distributions.description: Machine-readable CC BY 4.0 scope, permissions, attribution and AI/ML reuse guidance.

distributions.name: ARWP press facts
distributions.description: Canonical project facts, boilerplate, versions and source links.
